title: sideritis hirsuta subsp. emporitana
intro: Sideritis hirsuta subsp. emporitana, commonly known as a type of mountain tea plant, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine and has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis hirsuta subsp. emporitana include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
